Next I will check whether the momentum signals spread beyond pharma and whether the reversal rule fires often enough to reach 20 trades.

Only high-momentum-20d fires today (BAYN.DE, SAN.PA, both pharma, so sector concentration remains); IFX.DE missed the guidance-drift +2% confirmation and REP.MC's -3.30% drop is explained by Brent -3.52%. Next I will watch whether the pharma momentum names hold their highs and whether a no-news drop appears outside the oil names; the fourth slot stays empty on purpose to limit the number of ideas tried.
